user_prompt:
Map the following data source schema to the ontology.

DATA SOURCE: acled_data (type: relational)

SCHEMA:
  event_id_cnty: text — A unique alphanumeric event identifier by number and country acronym. This identifier remains constant even when the event details are updated. E.g., ETH9766
  event_date: text — The date on which the event took place. Recorded as year-month-day. E.g., 2023-02-16
  year: bigint — The year in which the event took place. E.g., 2018
  time_precision: bigint — A numeric code between 1 and 3 indicating the level of precision of the date recorded for the event. The higher the number, the lower the precision. 1, 2, or 3; with 1 being the most precise.
  disorder_type: text — The disorder category an event belongs to. Political violence, Demonstrations, or Strategic developments.
  event_type: text — The type of event; further specifies the nature of the event. E.g., Battles
  sub_event_type: text — A subcategory of the event type.
  actor1: text — One of two main actors involved in the event (does not necessarily indicate the aggressor). E.g., Rioters (Papua New Guinea)
  assoc_actor_1: text — Actor(s) involved in the event alongside Actor 1 or actor designations that further identify Actor 1. E.g., Labor Group (Spain); Women (Spain) Can have multiple actors separated by a semicolon, or can be blank.
  inter1: text — A text value indicating the type of Actor 1 (for more, see the section Actor Names, Types, and ‘Inter’ Codes).
  actor2: text — One of two main actors involved in the event (does not necessarily indicate the target or victim). E.g., Civilians (Kenya) Can be blank.
  assoc_actor_2: text — Actor(s) involved in the event alongside Actor 2 or actor designation further identifying ‘Actor 2. E.g., Labor Group (Spain); Women (Spain) Can have multiple actors separated by a semicolon, or can be blank.
  inter2: text — A text value indicating the type of Actor 2 (for more, see the section Actor Names, Types, and ‘Inter’ Codes).
  interaction: text — A text value based on a combination of Inter 1 and Inter 2 indicating the two actor types interacting in the event (for more, see the section Actor Names, Types, and ‘Inter’ Codes). E.g., Rebel group – Civilians
  civilian_targeting: text — This column indicates whether the event involved civilian targeting. Either "Civilians targeted" or blank.
  iso: bigint — A unique three-digit numeric code assigned to each country or territory according to ISO 3166. E.g., 231 for Ethiopia
  region: text — The region of the world where the event took place. E.g., Eastern Africa
  country: text — The country or territory in which the event took place. E.g., Ethiopia
  admin1: text — The largest sub-national administrative region in which the event took place. E.g., Oromia
  admin2: text — The second largest sub-national administrative region in which the event took place. E.g., Arsi Can be blank.
  admin3: text — The third largest sub-national administrative region in which the event took place. E.g., Merti Can be blank.
  location: text — The name of the location at which the event took place. E.g., Abomsa
  latitude: double precision — The latitude of the location in four decimal degrees notation (EPSG:4326). E.g., 8.5907
  longitude: double precision — The longitude of the location in four decimal degrees notation (EPSG:4326). E.g., 39.8588
  geo_precision: bigint — A numeric code between 1 and 3 indicating the level of certainty of the location recorded for the event. The higher the number, the lower the precision. 1, 2, or 3; with 1 being the most precise.
  source: text — The sources used to record the event. Separated by a semicolon. E.g., Ansar Allah; Yemen Data Project
  source_scale: text — An indication of the geographic closeness of the used sources to the event (for more, see the section Source Scale).
  notes: text — A short description of the event. E.g., On 16 February 2023, OLF-Shane abducted an unidentified number of civilians after stopping a vehicle in an area near Abomsa (Merti, Arsi, Oromia). The abductees were traveling from Adama to Abomsa, Arsi.
  fatalities: bigint — The number of reported fatalities arising from an event. When there are conflicting reports, the most conservative estimate is recorded.
  tags: text — Additional structured information about the event. Separated by a semicolon.
  timestamp: bigint — An automatically generated Unix timestamp that represents the exact date and time an event was uploaded to the ACLED API. E.g., 1676909320
  population_1km: double precision
  population_2km: bigint
  population_5km: bigint
  population_best: double precision
